title: Lesson 7: Final Check and Readiness Checklist
completionTitle: You've completed the OneAccord Digital Standard
keyConcepts: Use the right tool for the right job
Outlook for external and formal-record email; Teams channel posts for internal work
OneDrive for solo drafts; MOVE files to the channel to collaborate
The Hub for reference; Ninety.io for team alignment; label everything
nextTeaser: Welcome to the team. Questions about Ninety.io or the Hub? Ask Abby or Jesse.

blocks.html:
Lesson 7 of 7. You've learned the standard. Now let's check that you can apply it, then confirm your setup.

Core standards review

When you...Use...
Talk to a client, vendor or partner, or need a formal recordOutlook email
Discuss or decide something with your internal teamTeams channel post (always thread replies)
Ask a quick internal questionTeams private chat (move to a channel after 3 replies)
Need the whole team's attention at the all-team meetingNinety.io Headline
Draft aloneOneDrive (never your local hard drive)
Collaborate on or finalize team and client filesTeams channel Files tab (MOVE the file from OneDrive)
Look up official policies, forms and standardsSharePoint Hub (read-only)
Celebrate, share lessons or find events across the companyOneAccord Wins, Lessons, Resources team
Announce anythingLabel it Action Needed or Informed first

The one rule behind all of it: use the right tool for the right job.

blocks.prompt: A client emails you a question about project scope. Where do you reply?
blocks.feedbackIncorrect: Clients are external, so you reply in Outlook.

blocks.prompt: Four colleagues are going back and forth by email on an internal project issue. What should you do?
options: Move it to a post in the project's Teams channel
Start a private chat with one of them
blocks.feedbackCorrect: Correct. More than two people means a channel post.
blocks.feedbackIncorrect: An internal chain with more than two people moves to a channel post.

blocks.prompt: A private chat reaches its fourth reply and you're making a decision. What do you do?
options: Stop and move to a channel post or schedule a call
blocks.feedbackIncorrect: After three replies on a decision, move to a channel post or a call.

blocks.prompt: Your draft is ready for the team to edit. What's the correct hand-off?
options: Move the file from your OneDrive to the Teams channel's Files tab
Copy and paste it into a new file in the channel
blocks.feedbackCorrect: Yes. The hand-off is complete when the file is moved.
blocks.feedbackIncorrect: Use Move to so the file is moved, not copied or linked.

blocks.prompt: You need the approved brand standards. Where do you look?
blocks.feedbackCorrect: Right. The Hub holds official standards.
blocks.feedbackIncorrect: Approved standards live on the OneAccord Hub.

blocks.prompt: Leadership needs a formal, written record of an approval. Where does it go?
blocks.feedbackCorrect: Correct. A formal record calls for email.

blocks.prompt: You closed a big win. Where do you share it so the whole team recognizes it?
options: A private chat with your manager
An email to the whole firm
A Ninety.io Headline for the all-team meeting
blocks.feedbackCorrect: Right. Wins go in a Ninety.io Headline. You can also celebrate in #Wins.
blocks.feedbackIncorrect: Wins go in a Ninety.io Headline for the all-team meeting.

blocks.prompt: You're asking the team to start a new process. What must you do before sending it?
options: Label it Informed, to soften it
Send it as a private chat to each person
Label it Action Needed, and choose the channel that fits
blocks.feedbackCorrect: Correct. Every communication is labeled, and a new process is Action Needed.
blocks.feedbackIncorrect: A request to adopt a new process is Action Needed, and it needs a label and the right channel.

blocks.promptHtml:
Your manager asks you to prepare a client-ready proposal with two teammates, circulate it internally for feedback, send it to the client, and let the whole firm know when the client signs.

Walk through which tools you use at each stage: drafting, team input, sending to the client, storing the final, and sharing the win.
rubric: Starts the draft in OneDrive, not on a local drive
Moves the file to the project channel's Files tab for team input, and discusses in channel posts
Sends the proposal to the client by Outlook email and keeps the final version in the channel
Shares the win through a Ninety.io Headline, labeled appropriately
blocks.coachContext: End-to-end workflow: draft alone in OneDrive, never on the local hard drive; when teammates need to collaborate, MOVE the file to the project Teams channel's Files tab and discuss in channel posts (threaded replies); send the proposal to the client by Outlook email; the finalized client file is stored in the channel; a win is shared as a Ninety.io Headline for the monthly all-team meeting, labeled Informed (or Action Needed if asking for something).

blocks.label: Readiness checklist
blocks.instructions:
Confirm each item before you finish:

  • Teams is open and monitored throughout your workday.
  • OneDrive is syncing, and all OneAccord files are saved there, not on your local desktop.
  • MFA is enabled on your OneAccord account.
  • You've explored the OneAccord Hub (open it here).
  • You know where Ninety.io is, and that Abby is your contact for questions.
blocks.confirmText: I've completed my readiness checklist - continue
